title: Slow Mine
description: Makes mining blocks slower or faster based on your world difficulty
body:
# Slow Mine

This mod sets your mining base speed based on the world difficulty:

- Peaceful & Easy: 1.3
- Normal: 1.0 (default)
- Hard: 0.6

# Configuration

As of 26.1.2+beta.2, config support has been added to Slow Mine. On first launch the a new `slow-mine.json` will be generated in the `config` folder, with the following defaults:

```
{"speed_peaceful":1.3,"speed_easy":1.3,"speed_normal":1.0,"speed_hard":0.6}
```

Make changes and restart your game to load the new settings.

# Neoforge port(?)

Neoforge support is currently not decided. I want to minimize the dependencies for both the release mod and development work.

This mod is very small, [Sinytra Connector](https://modrinth.com/mod/connector) should be able to run this with no issues (please submit bug reports for any issue you run into).
